subject: You make me laugh.....
author: PsychedelicBabe
body: 😉You really do......for one i dont race on his tag and if i do its because hes too drunk and i talk on the headset so youd know if it was me....sometimes i wish it was....it drives me mad sitting here watching him race all my friends... by the times i get on in the early hours of the morning everyones retired for the evening.....sometimes i hate being such an early bird....but i guess it has its advantages...i mean i get to race Netters & Eezo stinking rotten drunk....which i find extremely entertaining......and it also reminds me why im a tee-total.....lololol......but yeah we do need to race more i suppose the next time well probably race will be in nitos tourney....i cant wait its going to be brilliant.....if i make it to the final ill be made up.....i was aiming for the win but looking at the line up and i realized that im dreaming......so making it to the final will be my goal....who knows eh?....i liked your comments about me being a nice person and that😳.....MAN WH*RE.......lololol i knew id find evidence though.......hahaha...

subject: A Massive Difference
author: ichienkai
body:
Yeah it's gotta be said this is a much more friendlier place to talk about and discuss Burnout in it's many guises, but honestly, I'm the worst kind of blogger on here!  Just so sparodic and the worst kind of respondeeee on topics etc

Too honest and open too.  BUT I think the atmosphere here is so very well balanced by Xandu and Zombietron.  Anyway Psych people might not agree (what with you having to defend yourself sometimes against spam claimers - over in the forums - they are 10 times more guilty of it)! but you are one of the friendliest racers you could meet and race against or talk to on forums- and yeah we do gotta race more but Paul keeps handing my arse to me a lot recently and I never know if it's you racing when he has the mic hehehe  Still Paul is very fast and I have to wonder if he just plain likes to kick my buttttt LOL

And you were right Psych about the Wh8re thing - ya got me dead bang!

--Bootleg is a window lickin' stalker--

subject: The Chilloutaholics.....
author: PsychedelicBabe
body: ❤️I love it in here its just so....i dont know?......chilled out....all you read throughout the threads is happiness and love for the game....and thats what it should be like....well done zombie & xandu for creating such a wonderful haven for all us Burnoutaholics....no matter what you write your opinions count no matter if there trivial or not....and you dont get flamed for writing the occasional dumb ass comment....of which im usually guilty off.....its funny you mentioning it really cos ive noticed over the last week or so that the other forum over the wall has been deserted.....wtf.....im trying to commit to both and cant cos i dont get any responses?......but i have to admit that i do prefer it in here.....its just so much nicer and pleasanter.......WELL DONE GUYS all your hard work and effort is paying off.......❤️ being cheeky but zombie & xandu if your reading can we have more smileys....💋.......theyre great....
